main_text.l: Atqui Hierarchia, seu Clerus Ecclesiæ Romanæ dominans
extenuat: religionem universam impietatis ejusdem la-
be attaminat; cum dæmonibus & hominibus mortuis,
ad veritatem ex iis expiscandam, familiare commerci-
um colit; Verbum Dei in exorcismis & benedictionibus
profanat; Baptismum exorcismis variis contaminat; in
Eucharistia certorum verborum murmure corpus Chri-
sti excantat; unctionibus certis, chrismati inprimis,
in Sacramentis spuriis eos effectus tribuit, quos nec à
natura, nec à Deo supra naturam operante habent; a-
muletis benedictis, verbis, figuris & numeris efficaciam
tribuit; fortuitis significationem affingit; Magiam per
remedia magica depellere conatur; Magos profossos, &
scripta consuetudinésque notorie Magicas in sinu fovet;

page.notes: Marginal notes at top right are small and heavily damaged (e.g. "apodissitio", "pragitur", "Propositio", "nis atrins", "que membrā", "sigillatim", "probantur"); they are only partly legible and are not transcribed. Scan edges and a faint watermark ("Digitized by Google") at the bottom right are omitted. Some words in the body are doubtful, notably "profossos" and "Magicas" and the Greek-less passages, which are marked as printed.
